abilities.name: The Unbroken Charge
abilities.text: Your units gain +3 combat strength when they attack. Capturing a city heals all your units.

abilities.name: The Royal Army
abilities.text: Gaining a military unit grants science equal to half its strength.

abilities.name: The Riders of the Steppe
abilities.text: Mounted units gain +1 movement on grassland and plains. Pillaging pays half again.

abilities.name: The Pax Mongolica
abilities.text: Your traders cannot be plundered. Trade routes pay +3 gold.

abilities.name: The Voices
abilities.text: Killing a unit pays faith, and presses your faith on the towns around the field.

abilities.name: The Maid
abilities.text: +4 combat strength on any ground that follows your faith.

abilities.name: The Enderun
abilities.text: Each Barracks gives +1 science, and +1 more for every great scholar and great general you have gained this game.

abilities.name: The Great Bombard
abilities.text: Your units gain +5 combat strength against cities. Capturing a city grants science equal to thirty times its population.

abilities.name: The Great Works of Qin
abilities.text: Garrisoned cities build wonders and buildings 25% faster.

abilities.name: The Registered Households
abilities.text: Every city gains +1 production for every three citizens.

abilities.name: The Qhapaq Ñan
abilities.text: Every city joined to your capital by road pays +1 happiness and +1 production.

abilities.name: The Gold of the Peaks
abilities.text: Farms pay +1 gold for every mountain standing beside them.

abilities.name: The Hospitals of the King
abilities.text: Freshwater farms gain +1 food and +1 faith for each public work in their city.

abilities.name: The Great City
abilities.text: Gain +1 culture and +1 faith for every four citizens in your empire.

abilities.name: The Dikes
abilities.text: In cities with an Aqueduct, farms give +1 science and +1 production.

abilities.name: Flower and Song
abilities.text: +1 culture for every two citizens in your capital.

abilities.name: The Cyrus Cylinder
abilities.text: Cities joined to your capital by road gain +1 happiness and +1 culture per Order in a Civic or Wildcard chair.

abilities.name: The King's Gardeners
abilities.text: Cities you found start with a Worker.

abilities.name: The Gold of Wangara
abilities.text: +2 gold on mines and camps, and +1 gold on every desert hex worked.

abilities.name: The Hajj
abilities.text: Trade routes that begin or end at a city holding a holy site pay +2 gold and +2 faith.
abilities.note: A road with a holy site standing at both ends is paid at both ends.

abilities.name: Books from the Ships
abilities.text: Your trade routes pay +2 science, and your foreign routes +2 more.

abilities.name: The Queen's Alliances
abilities.text: For each active deal, your capital gains +4 gold and +2 culture per age you have reached.

abilities.name: The Medici Bank
abilities.text: Gain +1 renown per turn for every eight gold your empire earns per turn after costs.

abilities.name: Florins
abilities.text: A city builds wonders 10% faster for every gold building in it.

abilities.name: The Storehouse of Wisdom
abilities.text: Faith buildings and science buildings give +1 science and +1 faith each.

abilities.name: The Learned Court
abilities.text: Completing a technology grants faith equal to a fifth of its cost.

abilities.name: Solomon, I Have Surpassed You
abilities.text: Completing a wonder grants faith equal to its production cost.

abilities.name: One Faith, One Empire
abilities.text: Each Holy Site gives +5 production. Each Holy Site a citizen works gives your empire +2 happiness.

abilities.name: The Correct Sounds
abilities.text: Every city gains +1 science and +1 culture for every four citizens.

abilities.name: The Royal Lectures
abilities.text: Each technology you complete grants three turns of renown, with the same share for each family.

abilities.name: A Guest at Every Court
abilities.text: One more chair in every government.

abilities.name: The Rihla
abilities.text: The first redraw of every hand you are dealt costs nothing — an Order, a doctrine or a great person, and never a belief.

abilities.name: The Mandate
abilities.text: Melee units gain +3 combat strength and +1 movement.

abilities.name: The Garrison Towns
abilities.text: Garrisoned cities pay +1 happiness and +15% culture.

abilities.name: The Riders of the Steppe
abilities.text: Mounted units gain +1 movement on grassland and plains. Pillaging pays half again.

abilities.name: The Herds
abilities.text: +1 production and +1 faith on every pasture.

abilities.name: The Great Works
abilities.text: Cities with a holy site make wonders 20% faster.

abilities.name: The Nile's Gift
abilities.text: +1 faith on farms that drink fresh water, from a river, a lake or an oasis alike.

abilities.name: The Mu'tazila
abilities.text: +1 science for every fifth point of faith your realm makes each turn.

abilities.name: The House of Wisdom
abilities.text: +2 food for every faith or science building a city holds.

abilities.name: The Poison King
abilities.text: +2 combat strength against an empire holding more cities than yours.

abilities.name: The Groves and the Hunt
abilities.text: +2 food on plantations and camps.

abilities.name: The Treasure Fleet
abilities.text: Ships gain +2 movement and +1 sight.

abilities.name: Tribute of the Western Ocean
abilities.text: Trade routes that begin or end at a coastal city pay +2 gold and +1 culture.
deferred: The first road you send to each foreign realm does not yet pay its lump of gold.

abilities.name: The Museion
abilities.text: +25% renown.

abilities.name: The Commentaries
abilities.text: A great person's work pays half again of what it makes.

abilities.name: The Rites
abilities.text: Cities keeping a rite pay +20% culture.

abilities.name: Symphonia
abilities.text: +2 culture and +2 production for every faith building a city holds.
